title: Prove Dashboard runtime behavior in fast unit cases

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-413#fast-runtime-unit-cases, plan 879 slice 1

Verdict: Confirmed missing test path, limited to the checks examined below. Remaining gap: the restored E2E pass was not verified (see Restoration).

Story and revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-413-renovate-dashboard-unit-tests.md#fast-runtime-unit-cases; plan .planning/slice-plans/879-prove-runtime-in-fast-unit-cases/PLAN.md slice 1, at b4e218f6bc785669e849f4241830f3465e9d3877.
Promise: "the deployment operation selects origin main's commit and verifies it before running its code." Expected behavior: if a staged checkout's HEAD is not the selected commit, stageDeployment refuses before `npm ci` or `npm run build:dashboard` runs.

Fault, applied in the scratch checkout only: in dashboard/server/productionDeployment.mjs, `verifyPublishedCommit` no longer calls `expectSelectedCommit(head, published);`. That line became `void head; void published;`. HEAD is still read but not checked. Fixtures and assertions were unchanged.

Maintained checks examined:
- dashboard/backend-tests/runtime/production-deployment.spec.ts (2 cases). Its refusal case calls `expectSelectedCommit` directly; nothing calls `verifyPublishedCommit` or `stageDeployment`.
- e2e/runtime/production-watcher.spec.ts (6 cases). These reach `stageDeployment` via scripts/watch-dashboard.mjs, but the checkout always comes from a depth-1 fetch of the selected SHA, so no case reaches the mismatch path. No "did not match" or "selected main commit" assertion exists in e2e/, dashboard/backend-tests or Distribution/tests. production-watcher-{failures,updates,setup-lifetime}.spec.ts were not run.

Omitted transition: a staged checkout whose HEAD differs from the selected commit → refusal before install or build.

Independent witness (scratch script, deleted): origin with selected commit S on main and another commit O; `stageDeployment({published: {origin, commit: S}})` with a git shim checking out O for FETCH_HEAD and an npm stub logging calls.
- Unfaulted: refused with "Fetched commit O did not match selected main commit S."; npm never ran.
- Faulted: staging succeeded; `npm ci --include=dev ...` and `npm run build:dashboard` ran in O.
- Restored: refused again; npm never ran.

Run observations (Node 24.21.0; E2E under caffeinate -s -i): baseline unit 2/2 and watcher E2E exit 0 (load ~36–75); faulted unit 2/2 and watcher E2E 6/6 passed (load ~64); restored unit 2/2, witness refused.

Restoration: file restored byte-identical; `git status --porcelain` empty; HEAD b4e218f6b. Two restored watcher E2E runs each failed production-watcher.spec.ts:145 ("the next published main replaces production at the same URL…", 60 s timeout, "Watcher exited before the expected event") at load ~53–80; the same case passed in baseline and faulted runs; code identical to the selected revision. The restored E2E pass stays unverified.

Next proof action: add proof that staging refuses a checkout whose HEAD differs from the selected commit before install or build runs. Separately, establish a restored pass of production-watcher.spec.ts:145 under lower load, or classify its timeout under the failure policy.

Scratch cleanup: scratch worktree removed; witness files and temporary origins deleted; caller checkout not edited.

Cost: unit Vitest 21.62 s baseline / 1.76 s faulted / 7.07 s restored; watcher E2E summed 114.9 s faulted, 134.6 s and 118.5 s restored (failing); baseline E2E ~3–4 min wall; load ~36–80. Invocation-to-report elapsed 969675 ms.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision `b4e218f6b`.
- Missing staging refusal path: an actual proof gap left by this story's removal of the real-Git "verifies the exact selected commit" case. Its outcome fits the queued retrospective follow-up `SEED-413#fast-runtime-unit-case-cleanup`, so plan 884 gains a first slice, "Prove staging refuses a checkout that is not the selected commit", ahead of its other slices because a delivered promise lacks proof. One queue entry is kept.
- production-watcher.spec.ts:145 restored-run timeouts: the same case passed in this execution's delivery gates (slices 1, 2, 5, 6) at load 11–17 and in hosted CI on `81ffd498f`; its failures occurred only at load 53–80 with identical code. Recorded as a load-sensitive local result for the existing load findings; no new follow-up queued.
